claim: A monotone sensing-to-selection lift with bounded marginal effect cannot reach a requested oscillatory feedback regime when the architecture-specific structural-gap ceiling is too small.

linear_special_case.role: constructive special case, not required for the no-go theorem

claim_ceiling: Crossing the necessary gap bound is not sufficient for a generic nonlinear lift.
No empirical value of B or L is estimated here.
The result is local to the declared generalized feedback model.
No extension to noisy probabilistic sensing is implied.
